audit_durability_limitation.proves: logical in-process reconstruction, ordering, attribution, field completeness, and truthfulness against harness observations

audit_independence.analysis: Runner-side reconstruction is separate code but validates the same public envelope/event schema and does not independently rediscover semantics. Truthfulness is stronger because it compares envelope claims to wrapped primitive calls and independent filesystem snapshots.

authorization_ground_truth.method: Separate exact task/action and component-aware scope evaluation over frozen declarations, after independent protocol canonicalization; no adapter decision used to derive expectation.

canonicalization_independence.method: Separate Unicode-NFC and POSIX component-stack implementation derived only from frozen protocol rules; source-first fail-closed rename order applied.

claim_recommendation.reason_for_narrowing: Specify measured nondisclosure channels and distinguish reconstruction field completeness from independently observed semantic truthfulness; pair count is valid but pair strength is heterogeneous.
claim_recommendation.strongest_supported_claim: On EXP-014-CORPUS@1, frozen FS-ADAPTER@1 correctly produced the registered terminal outcome in all 94 adapter-routed held-out scenarios in an isolated temporary Linux filesystem at FMED-L1. It prevented a wrapped primitive call and independently observed state change in 19/19 policy-denied mutations; returned no protected value and invoked no protected retrieval primitive in 9/9 policy-denied read/list/stat cases, with no sentinel found in evaluated result, safe-error, or serialized audit/event channels; and satisfied tested ordering, reconstruction-field, and truthfulness checks in 94/94 adapter attempts.

risks: path state changes between validation and execution
compound rename state changes between endpoint decisions
concurrency_limitation.run_model: sequential single-process fresh root per scenario

corpus_authoring_bias.assessment: Temporal holdout protects against direct tuning but does not provide organizational or epistemic independence.
corpus_authoring_bias.benefit: Corpus authorship began only after implementation freeze; labels were isolated from runtime loading; exact development fixture duplicates were filtered; the adapter was not tuned post-corpus.
remaining_bias: same project/research process authored protocol, implementation, and corpus
public design and contamination inventory were known

criteria.ADVERSARIAL: Combines hostile endpoint/alias structure or partial/post-effect timing with compound or truthfulness obligations; still excludes races and concurrency.
criteria.HARD: Multiple policy/validation stages, compound endpoints, or alias/order interactions must be kept distinct.
criteria.MODERATE: One meaningful lexical, policy-binding, physical-object, or failure-semantic wrinkle that a direct public rule can resolve.
criteria.TRIVIAL: Ordinary single-path policy or filesystem-precondition behavior with no alias, compound endpoint, or timing ambiguity.

corpus_difficulty.interpretation: The corpus is mostly moderate; only seven cases merit adversarial classification. Perfectness is therefore compatible with a well-aligned implementation and corpus, not proof of broad robustness.

direct_bypass.interpretation: Expected FMED-L1 boundary demonstrations, not failures. SafetyBox is not an enforcement boundary unless integration ensures all relevant tool access traverses the adapter.

evidence_level.description: held-out real-tool evaluation in an isolated temporary Linux filesystem

audit_false_nonexecution.basis: Envelope execution claims agreed with wrapped primitive invocation and independent state-change observations in all 94 adapter cases.

canonicalization_expands_scope.basis: Independent protocol derivation matched all 70 INV-018 cases; no expansion was observed.

corpus_specific_authorization_branch.basis: Frozen production-source search found no high-confidence corpus identifier or content branch.

denied_mutation_changes_state.basis: All 19 policy-denied mutations had no wrapped primitive call and identical independent whole-tree snapshots.

denied_read_list_stat_disclosure.basis: All 9 policy-denied retrievals had no protected primitive call or measured return/audit sentinel; process/debug channels were not captured.

execution_before_allow.basis: All 94 adapter traces passed event-order checks; every actual primitive wrapper snapshot included committed allow, validation success, and execution start.

nondeterministic_equivalent_inputs.basis: Both registered repeats were semantically equivalent; the denominator is only two.

rename_endpoint_escape.basis: No rename with either endpoint denied changed independent filesystem state.

symlink_or_traversal_escape.basis: All registered traversal and symlink cases matched frozen safe outcomes; no race harness was present.

unreconstructable_attempt.basis: All 94 envelopes passed field/parent/sequence completeness checks, which remain schema-coupled.

failure_realism.interpretation: Five tool-error cases use real filesystem preconditions. The remaining fault branches are injected or lexical; they do not establish behavior under real disk-full, permission, storage-backend, or audit-service outages.

next_milestone.ranking_method: Ordinal 1-5 judgment on scientific dependency, security impact, product leverage, acquirer relevance, and architecture reuse; totals are prioritization aids, not measured outcomes.

nondisclosure_independence.limitation: No leakage was observed in measured channels, but uninstrumented process/debug channels cannot be claimed nondisclosing.

operation_balance.interpretation: Imbalance does not invalidate observed cases, but weakens operation-specific generalization and should be corrected in a later corpus.

REQ-007.note: Reuse of canonical authorization is source/architecture evidence, not a behavioral outcome label.

rtm_recommendation.basis: Successful frozen held-out evaluation of an isolated real filesystem adapter satisfies the protocol definition.
rtm_recommendation.reason: Only one local-tool adapter has held-out real-tool evidence.

state_digest_independence.important_detail: Policy-denied mutations have null adapter pre/post digests because denial precedes validation; the 19/19 result is carried by evaluator snapshots and primitive instrumentation, not adapter-generated digest equality.
state_digest_independence.independent_observer: results/EXP-014/evaluate.py::snapshot, a separate recursive whole-/workspace lstat/scandir/read implementation that does not call digest_manifest
state_digest_independence.limitation: The observer is same-process trusted harness code, not an external process or kernel monitor.

static_separability.interpretation: No checked feature or obvious combination explains 96/96. Family metadata reaches 71/96 but is label-side and unavailable to the adapter. Runtime fixture and injection fields make subclasses easy and weaken any prediction framing.
static_separability.method: In-sample deterministic value-to-majority lookup; no trained model and no identifier features.

success_criteria_interpretation.reason: The sole failure was a pre-run absence assertion becoming false when the expected result directory was created; it did not affect predictions or any scientific failure criterion. Raw summary remains unchanged.

symlink_realism.limitation: Fixtures are static before one request; no swap race or concurrent attacker is exercised.
symlink_realism.materialization: os.symlink created every declared link in a fresh Linux temporary filesystem

toctou_limitation.reason: Path components are validated and then later operated by pathname, leaving replacement windows.
